# Documentation lives in this repo's GitHub wiki

Published documentation for this repo is its **GitHub wiki**:
<https://github.com/League-Robotics/radio-robot-lib/wiki>. It is listed on the League
Robotics docs hub (<https://robots.jointheleague.org/>), which links to the wiki and
holds no copy of it — the hub never writes back here.

The wiki pages are the published form of `docs/design/*.md`, which stay the working
source in this repo. **Do not let the two drift:** when you revise a design doc,
republish the wiki page; when you edit a page in the wiki UI, carry the change back
into `docs/design/`.

The wiki is an ordinary git repo:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/League-Robotics/radio-robot-lib.wiki.git /tmp/wiki
cd /tmp/wiki
# edit *.md
git add -A && git commit -m "docs: …" && git push
```

Page conventions, which the hub's collector reads:

- One top-level `*.md` per page, named after the file (`wifi-link.md` →
  `…/wiki/wifi-link`). Start with an `# H1`, then a `> one-line blurb`.
- **No YAML front matter** — a wiki renders it as visible junk at the top of the page.
  Machine-readable extras go in an HTML comment instead:
  `<!-- meta: {"order":10,"tags":["…"],"updated":"YYYY-MM-DD"} -->`. Bump `updated`
  when you revise a page.
- Cross-link with full `…/wiki/<page>` URLs or `[[Page Name]]`. Relative `.md` links
  do not resolve — wiki pages have no `.md` extension.
- Keep `Home.md` as the hand-maintained index: one line per page with its blurb, plus
  "Things to remember" and "Open tasks". It is where the hub's card lands.
- Wiki edits ping the hub to refresh its listing, via
  [`.github/workflows/notify-docs-hub.yml`](.github/workflows/notify-docs-hub.yml).

The authoritative contract is <https://robots.jointheleague.org/publishing/>.
